 Baleba, Rashford, Sesko - Man United injury news and return dates after Roma win
 Man United beat Roma in the Champions League at Old Trafford on Tuesday night but they picked up another injury worry in the process.
 Add to preferred sources Comments Sport Ross Jackson Head of Football 04:00, 04 Nov 2026 View Image Baleba joins Sesko and Rashford on the sidelines
 Manchester United looked to be heading for a tenth game without a victory on Tuesday night but a late Matheus Cunha double rescued them as they came from 2-0 down to beat Roma 3-2 .
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 One of the negatives from the game for the Reds was the injury picked up by Carlos Baleba. The midfielder pulled his hamstring early in the second half at Old Trafford and looked distraught as he limped off the pitch after receiving treatment.
 ‌ 
 Michael Carrick provided an update on Baleba after the game. We've everything the United boss said and all the other injury news coming out of Carrington in our round-up below:
 ‌

 Carlos Baleba
 Injury: Unknown
 Baleba picked up a hamstring injury early in the second half of United's win over Roma.
 ‌ 
 The midfielder was able to hobble off the pitch but was clearly distressed as he headed for the tunnel. After the game, Carrick said: "I haven't got any more news on Carlos at this stage, but obviously it looks... it's his hamstring, so we'll just have to assess what that looks like. Initially, it doesn't look great. Timelines, I haven't got much more to give you."
 Luke Shaw
 Injury: Unknown
 ‌ 
 Shaw did not feature in training on Monday. Carrick said earlier this week: "Luke definitely won't be around this week, and fit at that point."
 Potential return date: November 22 vs Liverpool 
 ‌ 
 Make sure you never miss the latest Manchester United news and opinion by making Manchester Evening News one of your Google preferred sources . 
 Marcus Rashford
 Injury: Hip
 ‌ 
 Rashford did not feature in training on Monday as he continues his recovery. "Marcus, we will just have to see day-by-day how he keeps improving," Carrick said on Monday.
 Potential return date: November 8 vs Aston Villa
 ‌ 
 Patrick Dorgu
 Injury: Thigh
 Dorgu has not featured since picking up a thigh injury on international duty but he did take part in the training on Monday.
 ‌ 
 "It was his first day with the group so it is great to have him back. He's worked ever so hard to be back with the group, but he won't be involved tomorrow. We will see how he progresses through the week but great to have him back," Carrick said of the Dane.
 Potential return date: November 8 vs Aston Villa
 ‌ 
 Benjamin Sesko
 Injury: Shin
 Carrick said on Friday: "Yeah, unfortunately Ben looks like he's going to be out for a period of time. We're still not clear of exactly how long, but it's going to be for a longer period of time.
 ‌ 
 "It was the process, as I said to you before, we had to go through the process, a bit of a healing process for the injury to see how it would react and what direction to go with that. Even now we're still working through it.
 "But it's unfortunate, obviously first and foremost, for Ben, for the kind of period that he's had, and tried to get through it and going through this again. And for us to not have him available is obviously a blow, but we'll try and get back, get him back as quick as we can."
 ‌ 
 Potential return date: January
 Manuel Ugarte
 Injury: Knee
 ‌ 
 Ugarte is a long-term absentee and will not feature until the back end of the season if he does make a comeback this term. He continues to recover from the serious knee injury that he picked up at the World Cup.
 Potential return date: 2027
